spans.text: It checks if Function Calling responses match the schema and all required fields exist. For Generation Agents, generated code is validated with compilers. On validation failure, retry or invoke Correct Agent.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates strong tool/action safety practices through multiple validation layers, compilation checks, schema validation, retry limits to prevent infinite loops, and structured error handling. The system validates generated code before execution and uses correction agents to fix issues.

spans.text: Most type errors are resolved in 1-2 iterations, with maximum retry count limited to prevent infinite loops.
